hints.title: Group Scores by Student Identifier
hints.text: Collect all test scores for each student into separate buckets grouped by student ID.

hints.title: Top Five Score Extraction
hints.text: For each student, sort their recorded scores in descending order and select the five largest values.

hints.title: Truncated Integer Mean
hints.text: Compute the average by summing the top 5 scores and applying integer division by 5. Output student records sorted by student ID.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: total score records in items
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-scanning full score arrays repeatedly incurs quadratic comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping scores and taking top 5 per student runs in O(N log S) time with linear auxiliary storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should group items by ID, extract top 5 scores, compute integer mean, and sort results by ID.
complexity.notes: Guaranteed that each student has at least 5 scores.
